title: Above Suspicion
subtitle: He is dear to me, but dearer still is justice.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Those so-called craftsmen were from the Cult of Kosmos.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: But they weren't here to destroy the temple. They only left some strange signs and patterns.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: The same symbols that were on the bounty.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: So then that bounty came from the cult too!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: So then, we know at least to look around for those symbols.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: That would be wise.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: There's still no sign of them ...

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: There was no sign of them in the Agora, Plaka, or the Panathenaic Way ...

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: I'm beginning to doubt myself; what did we see there? Could it really have been my brother?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It seems like there is no one else bearing those symbols near the Theater of Dionysos.
Their discussion is halted by the sound of huffing soldiers and groaning prisoners.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Girls, lookie here at what I've found. A bunch of goons with those odd symbols!
Regulus marches toward them like a successful hunter, followed by a cadre of Athenian Evzoni.
Her prisoners slouch in after them; their hands tied with wet ropes.

items.speaker: Evzone
items.text: Well met, Kassandra. Hopefully we can be of help.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Wait, what's going on here?

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Who are these people?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Did I miss a mic check or something? They are the bad guys!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: And thanks to this rockin' pirate captain, now they're our prisoners.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Good thing I ran into these Calzoni lads; they said they were only too happy to help us protect Perikles. Though, their methods are a mite rough.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Quick as a blade, you have the makings of a fine misthios, Regulus.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I just hope she didn't cause too much trouble.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: We'll have to uncover that for ourselves.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Fine.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Vertin, my true and reliable friend, my best mate, did you really doubt me?
They turn to the suspects together.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: First, I appreciate your cooperation with us at this time.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Now, we will proceed using logical deduction to determine your guilt or innocence. All we need to know is who among you has any relationship with the Cult of Kosmos.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Let's begin. You there.
The person called raises his head with a fearful look in his eyes.

items.speaker: Suspect I
items.text: Ladies! I-I confess—

items.speaker: Suspect I
items.text: I was watching some of the rich merchants on Hesidon Street; I saw these symbols and wanted to record them.

items.speaker: Suspect I
items.text: But I'm not a part of any cult! I'm just a clumsy painter.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: He's no cultist. Leave him to the Evzoni.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Next.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: A festive oil lamp for ... three Drachmae; festive wine ... 50 Drachmae, and a festive lyre for ... 600 Drachmae ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Could there be something behind these records?

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Let him go, Vertin. He isn't a cultist.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: He's just a cheat.

items.speaker: Suspect II
items.text: I-I didn't commit any crime!

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: No, all you've done is put "Festive" before the name of each of your wares so you could double or triple the price? Eh, Sotirius?

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: We misthios bleed and sweat for every coin we earn. While you win your coin with deceit.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Don't let me see you doing this again, or ...
She pats the spear on her palm and motions for the man to be escorted out by the Evzoni.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: And our next suspect is ...

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Over here, ladies.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: APPLe?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: The very same. Unfortunately, not even my closest and best mate is above suspicion.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: She holds back true grief in her voice.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: I don't even know what Mr. APPLe went through in that evil fruit basket, but I can only hope that we can set him right again.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: But Captain, this is just some honey and syrup that got stuck on my skin.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Not a secret mark from some cult.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: It is doubtful that the cult would take in an outsider so quickly—

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: —Especially an outsider like him.
Their suspects prove to be a dead end.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Kassandra, you already captured a suspected cultist, right?

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Yes, but he hasn't said anything of value and I don't think he knows much to begin with.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Except ...
She takes out the unsharpened file once more.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: I had hoped that it would give me something to find the source of this conspiracy, but now we know it is connected with the Cult of Kosmos.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: So, there is nothing more to be learned from him. Anything he tells us now will be out of fear of punishment; he's unreliable.
A thought strikes her.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: You mentioned that there were others there with the assassin? Did you catch anything else before they ran?

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: A little, yes. Though not enough to determine their plans.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Something about a "Sage" ... Wait.
The same spark leaps to her as memories return.

items.speaker: The Rookie "Actor"
items.text: So, how are we supposed to read these messages when they come? The Sage explained nothing to us ...

items.speaker: The Wise "Playwright"
items.text: That's none of your concern, fool!

items.speaker: The Rookie "Actor"
items.text: Seems like you don't know any more about the Sage's plans than I do.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: So this "Sage" is giving them orders.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: But we don't know who he is—

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We don't need to know.
She lets her statement rest for a short moment as she composes her plan.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: If I'm correct, all we'll need to do is claim the Sage is here ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... They're so disorganized they may not know we're bluffing.
The plan is presented confidently, and the listening APPLe bobs in agreement.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: That's very devious, Vertin. A bit of guile worthy of Odysseus.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: And you, Mr. APPLe, may come in handy, as we'll need your skill in Athenian performance.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Would you kindly share your skills with us? I have a feeling it will help our investigation immensely.
The seasoned mercenary takes in their words carefully.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: So, you're suggesting that we perform some sort of drama to lure these cultists out?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Yes, precisely. The cultists seem to be awaiting special orders. So let's give them what they're waiting for.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: I'm no actor. But ...

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Why not?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Then let's get started. We need to make this look believable. So, Kassandra, you'll need to bring us to the prison.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: How fun. Follow me.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: What?! Prison again?!
Prison, Athens
The "actor" had not expected any visitors.

items.speaker: The Rookie "Actor"
items.text: Who are you?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: You are Domitius, correct? I've been assigned as your Logographer, to assist you with your trial.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The Archons have accused you of being a member of the Cult of Kosmos, do you accept your charge?

items.speaker: The Rookie "Actor"
items.text: The Cult of ... I-I have no idea what you're talking about!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I see. And you're sure that you have nothing to do with them?

items.speaker: The Rookie "Actor"
items.text: Of course! I would never be a part of that horrific cult!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Of course not.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I've made my decision; I believe this man is innocent.
The strange-looking advocate raps her hand on the wall, and soon a familiar face appears.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Domitius.

items.speaker: The Rookie "Actor"
items.text: It's you! What are you going to do with me?!

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: I'll tell you what I'm going to do, I—I'm going to release you. It was my mistake ... your arrest ... brings shame to the Polis ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: To all of civilization, really.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: So, I will make things right.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Not only will you be released, but we will also publicly declare you innocent of your crimes.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I've prepared a declaration saying that you, Domitius are not a member of the Cult of Kosmos, and that you completely and thoroughly repudiate their actions. Which is why, when you discovered this bounty, you immediately surrendered it to the Archons.
She makes a great performance of his supposed innocence.

items.speaker: The Rookie "Actor"
items.text: What, but I-I didn't ...

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: In fact, all thanks to you, we uncovered the cult's plot and even managed to capture a key member.

items.speaker: The Rookie "Actor"
items.text: A key member ...

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: No need to be afraid, Domitius. We're interrogating the mastermind at this very moment.

items.speaker: The Rookie "Actor"
items.text: You don't mean ... the Sage?
He murmurs the words out in disbelief.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Ahem, and just think, Domitius, it was all because of you. We found the clues in your bounty sheet and broke your secret code.
She waves the file in her hand.

items.speaker: The Rookie "Actor"
items.text: But how did you decipher it? Ebatous hadn't told me how to read the scytale—
The unfinished words stick in his throat.
But it's too late.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Scytale? If my memory serves, it was a tool that Spartans used to encode their messages.
Rather than pain, the sound coming from next door turns into cheers.
The captured "mastermind" appears around the corner.

items.speaker: The Rookie "Actor"
items.text: A flying apple?! No, you mean you—

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Finally, we can end these theatrics.

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Did you discover what you needed to, APPLe?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Knowing that it is a scytale solves one major hurdle. However, we will still need the key to decipher it ...

items.speaker: Kassandra
items.text: Well then, it seems like we still have some use for you.
They all fix their sight on Domitius.

items.speaker: The Rookie "Actor"
items.text: Quit staring at me! I've figured out your game; I'm not talking!

items.speaker: The Rookie "Actor"
items.text: I won't tell you anything—!
